parsed.explanation: Transgender people in Nepal face substantial social stigma, family rejection, harassment and discrimination in employment, housing and healthcare. Some also report physical or sexual violence. A traveller who is visibly trans or outed could encounter hostile treatment from strangers or private service providers, although experiences vary considerably. Kathmandu has a visible LGBTQ+ community and supportive spaces; smaller or more conservative communities may offer less anonymity and support. Evidence specifically measuring risks to transgender tourists is limited, so the likelihood of a particular incident is uncertain.
